jei.draconic_clarity.crystal.relay: [Use] Balances energy between linked crystals. Flow changes with their charge levels.
jei.draconic_clarity.crystal.direct_io: [Use] Connects one adjacent machine. Input pulls energy from it; Output sends energy to it.
jei.draconic_clarity.crystal.wireless: [Use] Connects remote machines. Input pulls energy from targets; Output sends energy to them.
jei.draconic_clarity.binder.select: [1 — Select] Sneak-use the first crystal with the Crystal Binder.
jei.draconic_clarity.binder.connect: [2 — Connect] Use the second crystal or target machine. Repeat for more links.
jei.draconic_clarity.binder.clear: [Clear] Sneak-use the Binder in the air to forget the selected endpoint.
jei.draconic_clarity.binder.limits: [Limits] Both endpoints must be in range and each crystal must have a free link or target slot.
jei.draconic_clarity.crystal.limits.rela: [Limits] %s • stores %s • %s crystal links • %s-block range • no fixed OP/t rating.
jei.draconic_clarity.crystal.limits.dire: [Limits] %s • stores %s • %s crystal links • %s-block range • up to %s adjacent I/O.
jei.draconic_clarity.crystal.limits.wire: [Limits] %s • stores %s • %s crystal links • %s remote targets • %s-block range • up to %s per target.
jei.draconic_clarity.crystal.setup.relay: [How] Sneak-use one crystal with the Crystal Binder, then use the other crystal. Repeat for each link.
jei.draconic_clarity.crystal.setup.direc: [How] Place against a machine. Sneak-use empty-handed to switch mode. Link crystals with the Binder: sneak-use the first, then use the second.
jei.draconic_clarity.crystal.setup.wirel: [How] Binder-link it to the crystal network, then bind the wireless crystal and use each target machine. Sneak-use empty-handed to switch mode.
jei.draconic_clarity.crystal.live: [Check] Point Jade at the placed crystal to see current energy, used links, mode, and recent flow.
tooltip.draconic_clarity.kind.relay: Binder-link crystals; flow has no fixed OP/t rating.
tooltip.draconic_clarity.kind.direct_io: Adjacent I/O: up to %s • sneak-use empty-handed to switch mode.
tooltip.draconic_clarity.kind.wireless: %2$s targets • up to %1$s each • Binder-link targets.
tooltip.draconic_clarity.binder.connect: Sneak-use first endpoint → use second endpoint
tooltip.draconic_clarity.binder.clear: Sneak-use in air: clear selected endpoint
